mandates.name: Starhotels — Italian Hotel Portfolio
process: Detailed property, financial, and legal information provided thereafter
mandates.teaser: Portfolio of hotel properties and development projects associated with Starhotels S.p.A., one of Italy's leading private hotel groups, whose group portfolio spans 34 properties and 4,500+ rooms across Italy, London, Paris and New York. 2025 results: revenue €340M, record EBITDA €108M (~31.8% margin). Indicative, non-binding acquisition value €3.6B. Process: non-binding Letter of Intent, with detailed property, financial, and legal information provided thereafter and a meeting with representatives to follow. Full portfolio details available to qualified buyers under NDA.

mandates.name: Brazilian Multiple Bank
mandates.teaser: Acquisition of 100% shareholding control of an established Brazilian Multiple Bank, licensed in the National Financial System with 60+ years of history. Scaled-back operations, low credit exposure, strong capitalization (Basel Index ~141%, 1Q26). Total assets ~USD 12.1M, equity ~USD 10.8M. Indicative price ~USD 21.8M (R$120M). Headquarters building excluded. Process: NDA, information access, due diligence, definitive documents, regulatory approval. Full details available to qualified buyers under NDA.
